name: Yuzuki Naako
source:
The waitress at Ocean Way, the family restaurant the protagonist often visits.

A girl he's gotten close enough to chat with freely, without any unnecessary fuss, since he started going there a few months ago.

Even though she's working, whenever she spots the protagonist, she comes over to his table and they can talk about all sorts of silly things—a good friend.

But gradually, that closeness starts to become a significant obstacle for her...?

[From [url=http://www.ole-m.net/products/ironmaiden/chara.html]official site[/url]]
